subject: Follow-up & proposed short-retention arrangement for CloudSight trial
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@cloudsighthealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up & proposed short-retention arrangement for CloudSight trial

Alex — thanks again for the demo today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

Summary of customer ask:
- PII must never be written to persistent logs (PII redaction at ingress).
- System activity logs (non-PII) allowed, but retention must be shortened to 7 days for the trial and 30 days for production unless otherwise agreed.
- Data residency: trial traffic will be US-only; production may require EU region later.

What we propose for the 30-day pilot (actions):
1) Short-retention pilot profile: 7-day token & KV logs; separate ephemeral mode to avoid retention of any PII fields.
2) Ingress PII redaction: request to provide the initial list of PII types/fields.
3) Proof artifacts: we will provide our data flow diagram + audit log snippet and SOC2 section references for the trial.

Attachments: "rdw-short-retention-proposal.pdf" (proposal & config), "nda-redline-summary.docx" (pending legal notes).

Next steps / asks for CloudSight:
- Can you confirm the PII fields you want redacted (e.g., MRN, SSN, patient_name)?
- Will the CISO & legal want to review the short pilot SLA and the one-page audit excerpt?
- Ideal start date for the trial window?

We can be on a quick call tomorrow to finalize the list; Laura and Neha are looped for implementation/ops and privacy vetting.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0143

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@cloudsighthealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Miriam Patel <miriam.ciso@cloudsighthealth.com>, legal@cloudsighthealth.com
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up & proposed short-retention arrangement for CloudSight trial

Thanks Ben — appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers and some follow-ups from our side: 

PII: yes — MRN and patient_name must be redacted before anything is persisted. We also want email addresses to be hashed.
Retention: 7 days for any logs tied to the trial OK. For production we will expect 30 days but want the ability to request a shorter emergency purge.
Residency: trial traffic must be routed to us-west region (US). Production could require eu-west later — we'll flag that during procurement.

Legal/CISO review: Miriam (cc) will need a one-page tech summary and the pilot SLA. Legal will want to see the data flow diagram and a short statement on access controls.

Questions:
- Does the 7-day retention include KV cache or just persistent logs?
- What is the process for an emergency purge if we need to remove records before the 7-day window?

We'd like to start the pilot the week of Nov 22 — is that feasible?

— Alex
Alex Johnson
Senior Product Manager, CloudSight Health
alex.johnson@cloudsighthealth.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@cloudsighthealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Miriam Patel <miriam.ciso@cloudsighthealth.com>, legal@cloudsighthealth.com
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 15:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up & proposed short-retention arrangement for CloudSight trial

Alex / Miriam / Legal — good questions. Answers below and an operational path forward.

Answers:
- 7-day retention covers persistent request logs and token traces stored in our logging service as part of the pilot profile. KV cache used for active sessions is configured to be ephemeral and will not be persisted beyond session lifecycle unless you opt in; we can enable a true ephemeral KV mode for the pilot so that nothing is written to disk.
- Emergency purge: we have an API + ops playbook to trigger a targeted purge. For trial customers we execute within 24 hours of an authenticated purge request; for production we have an SLA-based process tied to legal requests. We'll include the purge runbook in the one-page tech summary.

Operational path & timeline:
- By Wed Nov 11: CloudSight to provide PII field list and confirm start window week-of-Nov-22.
- By Fri Nov 13: Redwood to send one-page tech summary, pilot SLA, and the audit log snippet. (See attachment: rdw-short-retention-proposal.pdf)
- Week-of-Nov-22: Kick off 2-week pilot in US-west region.

I've attached the proposal and a short NDA redline summary. If legal wants an alternate contract flow we can escalate to our commercial counsel; please let me know.

If you're available we can do a 20-minute alignment call tomorrow at 10am PT. Laura (ops) will cover config; Neha (privacy) will cover redaction and purge playbook.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: rdw-short-retention-proposal.pdf (PDF), nda-redline-summary.docx (DOCX)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: legal/ops next steps for CloudSight retention path

Ben / Laura — quick internal note after the thread w/ CloudSight. Legal flagged two items that will likely need explicit language in the pilot SLA:

1) Confirmed modes: ephemeral KV = no disk persistence; explicit statement in SLA that PII is redacted at ingestion for the pilot.
2) Emergency purge: define authentication flow and 24-hour execution commitment (ops playbook + audit trail).

I'll draft the one-page tech summary and the purge runbook excerpts today and drop in the Drive link. Also recommend we include the hashed-email transform (one-way) in the proposal to satisfy privacy team requirements.

— Neha
Neha Kapoor
Privacy & Compliance, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
